ev.q: During April–July 2022, the percentage of COVID-19 patients aged ≥20 years treated with Paxlovid was 36% and 30% lower among Black and Hispanic patients
Overall, 11.7% of COVID-19 patients were treated with Paxlovid, 2.7% with mAbs, 1.0% with Lagevrio, and 0.7% with Veklury.
the percentage of COVID-19 patients treated with Paxlovid increased from 0.6% in January to 20.2% in April and 34.0% in July
Paxlovid treatment among adults aged ≥20 years was 35.8% lower among Black patients (20.5% treated) than it was among White patients (31.9% treated)
Disparities for Black, multiple or other race, and Hispanic patients were present across all age strata
This study used EHR data from 30 sites (each representing one or more health care systems)

methods_quotes.q: Statistical differences in the percentage treated by race and ethnicity were quantified using Pearson’s chi-square tests
relative differences (absolute difference divided by the percentage treated in the majority group)
